top_signals.title: Olympic Council of Asia touts Asian Games as success despite logistical issues
top_signals.summary: OCA Director General Husain Al-Musallam said that at a time when the Games must be sustainable and financially viable, the Aichi-Nagoya model was one worth copying.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
